flexible.label: About flexible dates
flexible.text: Find flights within a travel window, choosing a range of nights for a round trip.

fixed.label: About fixed dates
fixed.text: Choose exact local departure dates out and back (one date for one way). The number of nights follows from the flights.

nights.label: About nights
nights.text: Counted like hotel nights. An arrival before 06:00 counts from the night before.

workHours.text: A departure after work end and a return before work start cost no leave day. These hours count leave days; they do not restrict flight times.

maxLeaveDays.label: About max leave days
maxLeaveDays.text: Working days only, excluding weekends and Polish public holidays.

localTimes.text: Local time at each airport, as on the ticket: departure at the departure airport, arrival at the arrival airport.

approximatePrice.label: About approximate prices
approximatePrice.text: Converted into PLN at the NBP mid-market rate because a flight is priced in another currency.

priceAge.label: About price age
priceAge.text: This is a stored price and may have changed. Check the current price on Ryanair’s site.

separateTickets.label: About separate tickets
separateTickets.text: A self-transfer is at your own risk. Nobody guarantees the next flight if the first is late.
